headline: Molokai Planning Commission

meeting.summary: The commission unanimously approved a home renovation project and moved its December 11 meeting to 1 p.m.
meeting.recap: The commission took up a special management area (SMA) exemption for renovating a single-family home.[[0:05:47]] The plans add a TV room and a second story with two bedrooms, two bathrooms and an office.[[0:06:02]] The staff planner said the department recommends the project is not a "development" under state law.[[0:07:27]] The planner said the home is outside flood hazard zones and away from the shoreline.[[0:08:09]] The applicant's consultant said the home's water meter allows no more water fixtures after this project.[[0:11:46]] No one testified on the item.[[0:13:41]] The commission approved the project unanimously in a roll call vote.[[0:15:50]] Staff said that meeting may include a landfill update the commission asked for.[[0:18:12]] The chair agreed to 1 p.m. after counting six commissioners available.[[0:19:09]] The chair said the next regular meeting is December 11, 2024, at 1 p.m.[[0:20:09]]
meeting.next: The chair asked commissioners to email the chair ideas for training sessions.

moments.q: Consultant explains the water fixture limit
Roll call vote: motion passes unanimously
